Calabar: the Civil War page the author opened says 'On 17 October 1967 Nigerians invaded Calabar', so a Calabar gain (October 1967, confidence 2) can be added with the mirror loss in biafra. The Boko Haram insurgency: the group held territory in Borno, Yobe and Adamawa from August 2014 to March 2015, and ISWAP has held ground around Lake Chad since (my recollection, not checked on a page). There is no contest event and the author's notes do not mention it.
